cases.purpose: Observe setsid fork with a leader caller or terminal, using default.
cases.oracle: util-linux setsid in the pinned VM; independently read PID/PGID/SID, private PTY session ioctls and gated child wait results. A trusted Python setsid/TIOCSCTTY setup control proves each mechanism before candidate behavior.
cases.comparison: Exact semantic process/session and controlling-terminal relations, return timing relative to a closed child gate, exit/wait status and raw diagnostics. The reference shell execs util-linux so the tested caller PID/group role is preserved. Both sides reap their owned children; raw identifiers are retained in supplemental diagnostics.
cases.stdout:
caller group leader yes
helper executed yes
new session leader yes
fork yes
returned before release yes
child status 7
invocation status 0
owned children reaped
